items.title: Reddit is Up 11% Premarket After S&P 500 Addition. Here’s How Other New S&P 500 Stocks Performed.
items.summary: Index funds may be forced to buy nearly three times Reddit's average daily trading volume after its S&P 500 announcement, but a look at the last twelve additions to the benchmark tells a very different story about what happens next.

items.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
items.summary: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.

items.title: 2 Services Stocks to Research Further and 1 We Question
items.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. These firms have helped their customers unlock huge efficiencies, so it’s no surprise the industry has posted a 20.5% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 8.8 percentage points.
